items.title: Always-on, grounded, and going agentic: How TGS built Scout on AWS Quick
items.summary: How TGS gave 322 geoscientists across seven offices and 15 time zones a trusted, citation-grounded AI support agent built on AWS Quick. Scout cut time-to-solution-discovery from hours to minutes and moved from search to conversation to action, driving organic adoption and about 1,590 productivity days returned.
items.creator: Elizabeth Chen
